deep_analysis:
2 open trades, both marginal: CRV SHORT -0.27% (0.8h) and BTC LONG +0.14% (2.8h). Neither is broken; neither is thriving. Portfolio is balanced 1L/1S in a market that has no committed direction — BTC sits AT EMA300 with acceleration NEGATIVE, 15m SHORT_BIAS vs 4h LONG_BIAS, Wyckoff DISTRIBUTION, velocity SLOW. This is chop, and chop is where hard_max_loss trades go to die (52/56 never reach +0.40% trail arm).

The 24h book is unambiguous about which side pays: longs +$0.96 net (16T, 9W) vs shorts -$0.53 (6T, 1W). The three biggest wins were pump-chain+ LONGs entered at RSI 63-67 during volume expansion — IOTA +14.7%, BANANA +10.1%, ICP +15.2%. The four pump-chain- SHORT losses (IO -2.43%, DOT -1.97%, APT -2.93%) all died on ATR SL hits at meta_rsi 47-56 — mid-band, not oversold, not overbought. They were chop shorts: entered after the dump had already happened, against a tape that bounced. The WINNING side of those trades was the LONG of the same bounce. pump-chain+ LONG captured it; pump-chain- SHORT got run over. 7d pump-chain- SHORT: 34T, 26.5% WR, net -$0.09 — structural bleed, not bad luck.

Open CRV SHORT is this exact pattern live. CRV 5m regime SHORT_BIAS conf 79.4 supports the direction, but entry RSI 48.21 is mid-band — the same zone where 14 shorts in the bleed cluster entered. Stop 0.35161 is only ~0.27% above current price; one BTC bounce off EMA300 and it's an ATR SL hit like IO/DOT/APT. Would not open this fresh. Thesis still marginally valid only while CRV holds below 0.352; if BTC reclaims EMA300 with volume, exit immediately.

BTC LONG is the better of the two: entered AT the EMA300 pivot (82006 vs ema300 ~82165), 4h LONG_BIAS, trend_quality STRONG_UP. If EMA300 holds, this is where trends start. If it breaks with volume, exit — no heroics in DISTRIBUTION phase.

AI Trader pick: GRASS LONG (conf 72). Precheck passed all gates. LONG_BIAS 77.5 slow grind +0.4%, RSI 65 in today's winning band, vol 0.79% — best regime-aligned gate-clearing setup available. INJ had better R:R geometry (2.05, multiplier 1.00) but NEUTRAL regime = chop entry; skipped it on purpose.
regime_context:
BTC AT EMA300 (~82165), price 82084, 113 consecutive minutes below, zscore -0.57 NEUTRAL. Velocity SLOW, acceleration NEGATIVE, linreg 15m slope negative, 1h slope slightly positive — mixed micro, no commit. Wyckoff DISTRIBUTION, market phase CALM, volume NORMAL but effectively quiet. 15m scanner: SHORT_BIAS. 4h scanner: LONG_BIAS, trend_quality STRONG_UP. Continuum: AT.

5m aggregate: 14 LONG_BIAS / 41 SHORT_BIAS / 71 neutral = SHORT_BIAS overall. Strong long movers already ran: TIA +3.66% (95 conf), ZRO +3.52% (95 conf) — chasing after a 3.5% move is the WLD/JUP failure pattern. Strong short candidates: ANIME -1.58% (92 conf), NXPC -3.36% (87 conf) — mostly no price data or RSI hard-floored for entry.

This is a mixed tape with a bullish higher-timeframe and a bearish immediate tape. The correct stance: lean long on regime-aligned grinds with volume (GRASS profile), avoid mid-band shorts (CRV profile), and do not chase extended movers. Chop regime historically degrades trail-family edge until BTC commits direction — position sizing should reflect that, but directional bias stays LONG per the 4h structure and the 24h PnL split.
